plan.selection_reason: Fixed ten-second segment from the accepted reduced-render street run, covering walking and camera turning. Its recording started near simulation 28.3s; exact capture initialization offset remains a limitation.
plan.model: Pinned Depth Anything V2 Small, unchanged author preprocessing, FP32, short side 252. One new static export if 2560x1440 changes tensor aspect ratio; no FP16 variants or model changes.
plan.parity: First decoded frame CPU FP32 versus DirectML, normalized by CPU output range. Maximum <=0.001 and mean <=0.0001. Preserve all finite predictions and source presentation timestamps.
plan.normalization: Freeze grayscale min/max from the first prediction only. Clamp visualization only, retain unclamped floats and per-frame out-of-range fraction. Never rescale each frame or fit the reserved segment.
plan.timing: RX 7800 XT DirectML index 0 with no CPU execution fallback; game/Workbench stopped. Five first-frame warmups then one synchronized inference for every source frame, including upload/readback. Report all calls, preprocessing separately, and exclude decoding, optical flow and PNG/video encoding from model-call timing.
plan.correspondence: Diagnostic only: adjacent 448x252 RGB grayscale frames, Farneback both directions (pyr_scale=.5, levels=3, winsize=15, iterations=3, poly_n=5, poly_sigma=1.2, flags=0). Backward warp previous output. Reject outside coordinates, forward/back closure >1px, grayscale residual >12 codes, or current Sobel gradient magnitude <=5. Restrict x 5..95%, y 5..80%, excluding a central 5%-wide/high crosshair region. Report coverage and delta divided by fixed first-output range. Flow rejects some occlusions but does not certify correspondence or metric geometry.
plan.motion_scope: Actual camera-relative depth changes with walking and turning; this difference is not a pure flicker measurement. Passing limits cannot establish semantic or temporal correctness. Visual failures override numeric feasibility, and weak correspondence makes the diagnostic inconclusive.
plan.review: Review the entire 10-second original-speed source/depth comparison with fixed grayscale range, plus native-size RGB and full-size depth at segment times 0, 3, 7 and the final frame. Inspect weapon/HUD, roof openings, poles, foliage and broad depth pumping. Last three seconds reserved, no retuning.
plan.video: Each source frame gets one side-by-side PNG. Preserve relative source PTS in a 60Hz-timebase concat, with no generated motion. Verify output PTS against source PTS and retain any discrepancy. Visualization and H264 encoding are offline diagnostics, not live application FPS.
plan.decision: No lighting effect, training target or live integration is accepted by this test alone. Retain failed output and use source fallback in any later effect where geometry is unreliable.

source.scope: Download and provenance only; no inference or appearance result

encoding.transformation: Every 2560x1440 source frame area-resized to 896x504 beside its 448x252 relative depth, bilinear enlarged to 896x504 with fixed first-frame min/max and visualization-only clamp. 32px labels. H264 CRF20, YUV420p, ten seconds at original relative timestamps, verified for all 600 frames. No generated motion or audio.
encoding.contact_scope: All 600 frames in chronological source/depth thumbnails, 224x126 per panel. This is an exhaustive contact-sheet review aid, not a claim of real-time playback inspection or thin-feature acceptance.

review.scope: All twelve chronological contact sheets covering 600 frames inspected at original 2240x1440 sheet size (224x126 per RGB/depth panel); all eight key PNGs inspected at native 2560x1440. Real-time playback inspection was not completed.
review.plan_deviation: The planned entire-clip 1x playback review remains unfulfilled. Exhaustive thumbnails and four native-size key pairs do not establish full temporal or thin-feature acceptance.
review.geometry: Walking and camera turning are present. Broad road gradients, building massing, near poles and trunks persist. Windows and door recesses flatten into walls; roof fittings, antennas, foliage gaps and thin railing depth remain incomplete or softened.
review.hud: Small corner HUD text and the crosshair do not create an obvious large foreground shape in the reviewed maps. A small inspection prompt appears at the end. Large weapons, menus, scopes and semantic HUD protection remain untested.
review.range: The visualization uses the first prediction range for all frames. Broad-plane gray levels change, including expected camera-relative depth changes; this is not a pure flicker measurement. No per-frame fit or reserved-segment tuning.
review.decision: Retain this as a coarse offline depth diagnostic only. The 15.885 ms p95 model call fails the provisional 15 ms limit, and 30.162 ms median CPU preprocessing makes this Python workflow unsuitable for the live target. No normals, per-pixel relighting or live integration accepted.
review.unknown: No appearance gain, complete game performance, live latency, peak GPU memory, physical input or broad environment/HUD acceptance measured by this test.
